text: The coverage in Iraq is limited to a single trekker in the **Iraqi National Museum** in Baghdad.
text_zh: 伊拉克的街景覆蓋僅限於巴格達的**伊拉克國家博物館**（Iraqi National Museum）內的一個徒步拍攝。

text: All of the coverage in Iraq is taken by a **trekker** with a camera similar to **Gen 2 **but with distinctly worse image quality and colour. This coverage tends to be overexposed, even becoming blindingly so [at some points](https://goo.gl/maps/YyzKFREKZvguinm16).
NOTE: This camera quality is sometimes referred to as Gen 1.5.
text_zh: 伊拉克的全數覆蓋都是由**徒步拍攝**所拍攝，其相機類似**第二代**，但畫質與色彩明顯更差。這種覆蓋通常曝光過度，[在某些地方](https://goo.gl/maps/YyzKFREKZvguinm16)甚至刺眼。
注意：這種相機品質有時被稱為 Gen 1.5。

text: The trekker blur has a well-defined, **pointed** **shape**.
text_zh: 徒步拍攝的模糊效果具有明確定義的**尖銳****形狀**。

text: The only piece of coverage outdoors is a small patio with a diagonal walkway. In this patio you can see many **date palms**.
This is the only piece of the coverage that can rarely appear on serious maps.
text_zh: 戶外唯一的街景覆蓋是一個帶有對角走道的小露台。在這個露台上你可以看到許多**棗椰樹**。
這是唯一很少會在嚴肅地圖（serious maps）中出現的街景覆蓋。

text: The inside of the museum features statues, steles, a variety of [artefacts](https://goo.gl/maps/WXRcTXkZSMVuChJK6), and a few [back rooms](https://goo.gl/maps/cjfVfUA3sbEWXegF6).
text_zh: 博物館內部有雕像、石碑、各種[古物](https://goo.gl/maps/WXRcTXkZSMVuChJK6)，以及幾個[後方房間](https://goo.gl/maps/cjfVfUA3sbEWXegF6)。
